summary: Tested logo/attachment relative-path storage fix. Uploads correctly return relative paths and initial save works. Display via getFullLogoUrl works correctly. However, discovered a regression bug in OrganizationDetails.js where re-saving without re-uploading logo converts the stored relative path back to an absolute URL, defeating the fix.

ui_bugs.issue: In fetchOrganization (lines 334-338), a relative logo URL from DB is converted to an ABSOLUTE URL (BACKEND_URL prepended) and stored in formData.logo. When the user opens Edit and clicks Save WITHOUT re-uploading a new logo, handleSubmit (line 615) sends this absolute URL back to /api/organizations/my PUT, storing an absolute URL in the DB. This exactly reproduces the original bug (logo disappears when deployment domain changes).

action_items: Fix OrganizationDetails.js fetchOrganization: DO NOT convert relative logo path to absolute URL when populating formData. Keep formData.logo as the relative path exactly as stored in DB.
Update logo preview img in edit mode (line 795) to use getFullLogoUrl(formData.logo) instead of formData.logo directly, so relative paths render correctly regardless of frontend/backend origin.
After the fix, re-test the Edit-without-reupload-then-Save flow to confirm PUT body logo field remains relative (/api/files/{id}/view).
critical_code_review_comments: OrganizationDetails.js lines 334-338 introduce an asymmetry: fetch converts to absolute, upload stores relative, save sends whatever is in formData. This causes silent data corruption on subsequent saves.
OrganizationManagement.js (SuperAdmin) correctly uses formData.logo = org.logo directly without conversion; display uses getFullLogoUrl helper. This is the correct pattern.
invoice_history upload (OrganizationManagement.js line 1259) stores response.data.url (relative) directly - correct.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded a small test PNG logo for ORG1 (file_id 6d21570a-c1cf-4239-9f0e-3a2a6bd116cf). Real logo may need to be re-uploaded by user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) Upload API POST /api/upload/evidence returns relative path /api/files/{id} (200 OK). (2) After fresh upload, PUT /api/organizations/my body.logo = /api/files/{id}/view (relative) - CORRECT. (3) Display img resolves via getFullLogoUrl(BACKEND_URL + relative) and loads with naturalWidth>0 - CORRECT. (4) BUG: Opening Edit (without re-upload) and clicking Save sends ABSOLUTE URL back - this is the regression. Root cause: fetchOrganization lines 334-338 convert relative->absolute in formData.logo. SuperAdmin org creation flow (OrganizationManagement.js) does NOT have this bug.
rca of the issue: OrganizationDetails.js.fetchOrganization contains legacy code (lines 334-338) that prepends BACKEND_URL to non-http logo paths before storing in formData. This was likely leftover from before the relative-path fix. Since formData.logo is what handleSubmit sends on save (line 615), any edit-and-save operation without a fresh upload will overwrite the relative path in DB with an absolute URL. Reproduction: 1) Login as admin. 2) Upload logo (stored as relative). 3) Click Edit again. 4) Click Save without changing anything. 5) DB logo field is now absolute URL. Mitigation: remove lines 334-338 conversion; use getFullLogoUrl(formData.logo) for the edit-mode preview img at line 795.
